title_sq: Ne Kompleksin "Olive Park", Ne Sauk, Shitet Super Vile !!!!
description_sq: Tek Rezidenca "Olive Park” ne Sauk, shitet Vile me cmim okazion ne faze suvatimi !! Olive Park eshte nje projekt i ri me vila dhe apartamente, me nje vendndodhje shume te mire, ne mes te gjelberimit dhe ajrit te paster. Kompleksi rezidencial modern ndodhet ne Sauk, buze rruges se “Elbasanit”, shume prane Liqenit Artificial.Vila organizohet ne 2 kate mbi toke dhe 1 kat nentoke, ku siperfaqe parcele eshte 389.5m² nga te cilat siperfaqe totale e viles 295m² ,me pishine ne pjesen e pasme te viles dhe parkim jashte ne oborr.Vila ka orientim Jug-Lindje dhe organizohet si me poshte; Kati -1 me siperfaqe 95m² ka ambient per kantine, palester ose studio, etj, depo, dhome teknike per vilen, dhome teknike per pishinen, tualet. Kati 0 me siperfaqe 93.1m² ka sallonin me 3 ambiente, gatimi+ngrenie+ndenjie me fasade qe akseson nga pishina, dhome gjumi dhe tualet. Kati 1 me siperfaqe 106.9m² ka korridor,dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar dhe dalje ne ballkon, tre dhoma gjumi te tjera me ballkon me vete dhe nje tualet te dyte. E gjitha taraca e Viles eshte e shfrytezueshme me sip 106.9 m/2 e rrethuar me xham te temperuar ne lartesine 1.20m2. Po ashtu vila ka 2 poste parkimi mbi toke. Rezidenca eshte unike bashkekohore ne llojin e saj, ku gjelberimi, kopshtet dhe hapesirat publike zene nje perqindje te konsiderueshme te siperfaqes se truallit. Rezidenca Olive Park do te ofroje punime shume cilesore, arkitekture moderne, me drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites fale orientimit shume te mire Jug-Lindje, standart te larte jetese, komoditet, ambiente rekreative si fushe tenisi dhe futboll/basketboll, siguri dhe administrim 24 ore, sherbime mirembajtjeje etj. Projekti eshte projektuar ne harmoni me natyren e cila ju jep mundesi banoreve te jetojne shendetshem ne privatesi dhe te shijojne peisazhet dhe oborret e gjelberuara.
title_en: In "Olive Park" Complex, in Sauk, Super Villa for Sale!!!!
description_en: At the Residence "Olive Park" in Sauk, Villas for sale at a bargain price in the plastering stage!! Olive Park is a new project with villas and apartments, with a very good location, in the middle of greenery and clean air. The modern residential complex is located in Sauk, on the edge of the "Elbasan" road, very close to the Artificial Lake. The villa is organized in 2 floors above ground and 1 floor underground, where the plot area is 389.5m², of which the total area of the villa is 295m², with a swimming pool at the back of the villa and parking outside in the yard. The villa has a South-East orientation and is organized as follows down; Floor -1 with a surface area of ​​95m² has room for a canteen, gym or studio, etc., storage room, technical room for the villa, technical room for the pool, toilet. Floor 0 with a surface area of ​​93.1m² has a living room with 3 rooms, kitchen+dining+living room with facade that accesses from the pool, bedroom and toilet. The 1st floor with an area of ​​106.9 m² has a corridor, a double bedroom with a dedicated toilet and access to the balcony, three other bedrooms with their own balconies and a second toilet. The entire terrace of the Villa is usable with an area of ​​106.9 m/2 surrounded by tempered glass at a height of 1.20 m2. The villa also has 2 parking spaces above ground. The residence is unique contemporary in its kind, where greenery, gardens and public spaces occupy a significant percentage of the land surface. The Olive Park residence will offer high-quality works, modern architecture, with natural light throughout the day thanks to the very good South-East orientation, high standard of living, comfort, recreational facilities such as tennis and football/basketball courts, 24-hour security and administration, maintenance services, etc. The project is designed in harmony with nature, which gives the residents the opportunity to live healthily in privacy and enjoy the green landscapes and courtyards.
